properties.project_name: P27 -- oval running track and field (south of UCSF Medical Center)
properties.digitized_from: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 8723003, 8723004 and 8723006 (mapped 2001-03-20, 2003-02-05; active), joined into one outline; the earlier outline came from: Traced as the leftover open ground between DataSF's official street centerlines and neighbouring mapped shapes near the UCSF Medical Center campus. Of the separate pieces this left, Pier & Point picked by hand the one showing an oval running track and central field (clearly visible on satellite imagery) as P27's real extent; not taken from a surveyed parcel.
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-20: the owner corrected the prior resolution (which had P27 'absorbed into the hospital's own footprint, not a separate parcel') using the numbered real-gap-fragment technique -- fragment 29 (11,734 sqm), a real oval running track with a central grass field and surrounding path, sits as its own real feature just south of the hospital campus, bounded by real streets on all sides and not overlapping any already-tracked polygon. Used as-is, no trim needed. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: FLAGGED FOR THE OWNER, nothing changed. Nothing is cited for the identification of fragment 29 as P27, and the audit found it doubtful: the traced oval (centroid about -122.3915, 37.7647; 11,722 sqm) sits just north of Mariposa St and just west of 4th St, where Mariposa Park is (Potrero View, 2016-03-19: 'located ... at Mariposa and Fourth streets'; SF Rec & Park: 'Mariposa Street and Owens'; UCSF's Dec 2024 map reportedly labels 'MARIPOSA PARK (CITY)' just south of the hospital campus). OCII numbers Mariposa Park P26, not P27, and OCII's Sept 2023 deck lists P27 as 'when built', so showing P27 as complete is doubtful. Its 'one-seventh mile walking path shaped like a butterfly's wing' could read from above as an oval track. The owner should compare the label against OCII's 2019 Land Use Map (which reportedly puts P26 as the large green parcel between Owens St and the curved street, and P27 as a thin sliver west of Owens St) before the name, P-number or status is changed. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat, digitized_from reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'APPROXIMATE -- real running track/field per Esri satellite imagery and the street/already-tracked-polygon-bounded gap computation, not a surveyed footprint or named park record. Name and operator not confirmed by any source found in this pass.'; digitized_from: 'Real-gap-fragment technique: bbox.difference(street buffer).difference(already-tracked polygons) near the UCSF Medical Center campus. The owner reviewed the numbered fragment map and identified fragment 29 (an oval running track and central field, clearly visible on satellite imagery) as P27's real extent.'. REPLACED 2026-10-12 (shape; status and use unchanged): the owner approved building records whose outline matches an Assessor lot at 85% or better, both ways, using the lot (CLAUDE.md, 'An official parcel beats our drawing'). DataSF's Assessor layer (data/raw/parcels.geojson) has the union of Assessor lots 8723003, 8723004 and 8723006 (8,217 m2, active, mapped 2001-03-20, 2003-02-05); the earlier outline of 11,713 m2 and the lot overlap with IoU 0.70 (70% of the earlier outline lies inside the lot and it covers 100% of the lot). The outline is now their union using the lots' own vertices (no simplification). geometry_type stays 'real'. properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is the union of Assessor lots 8723003, 8723004 and 8723006 (8,217 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the open ground left between street centerlines and neighbouring mapped shapes, hand-picked as the oval track and field (not a surveyed parcel); 70% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 100% of the lot. That these three lots are the track and field is Pier & Point's inference from location and imagery: they cover the oval and lie almost entirely inside the earlier outline; no source read ties the lot numbers to P27. The earlier outline also took in the parking lot to the north, which is part of lot 8723008 and is no longer in this record. Name and operator not confirmed by any source found.
properties.notes: OCII plan open-space parcel P27. A real oval running track and central field immediately south of the UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay campus.
